turns.text: It is, honestly, the same techniques that they're using for gambling.
turns.zh: 说实话，这跟赌博用的就是同一套手法。

turns.text: They want you to sit there lifeless, thoughtless, mindless for hours, because they want you there constantly.
turns.zh: 他们就想让你毫无生气、不动脑子、没心没肺地在那儿坐好几个小时，因为他们想让你一直待在那儿。

turns.text: And you don't know if you're going to get something interesting, funny, or exciting.
turns.zh: 而且你根本不知道会不会刷到有意思的、好笑的或者让人兴奋的东西。

turns.text: So, you just keep scrolling, and that unpredictability is what keeps you hooked, right?
turns.zh: 所以你就一直往下滑，而正是这种不可预测性让你上瘾，对吧？

turns.text: There's no way it's just willpower.
turns.zh: 这绝对不只是意志力的问题。

turns.text: I I really like what you said about the itching powder.
turns.zh: 我真的很喜欢你刚才说的那个「痒痒粉」的比喻。

turns.text: That like that really That really was a good a good metaphor um thinking about It's like, "Oh, well, it's your fault.
turns.zh: 那个真的……那个真的是个很好的比喻，嗯，想想就觉得，就像「哦，好吧，那都是你自己的错」。
